email_provider.label: Email delivery
email_provider.summary: Transactional email delivery is live through the configured Ferocity sender.
email_provider.fallback: Draft and copy the message for manual sending.

resend_shared.label: Ferocity-managed email
resend_shared.summary: Ferocity-managed outbound email is live. Mailbox ingestion is a separate capability.
resend_shared.fallback: Draft and copy the message for manual sending.

twilio.label: Customer-owned Twilio
twilio.summary: The adapter exists; each customer must connect valid credentials and complete applicable messaging compliance before live use.
twilio.fallback: Use the native SMS handoff or copy-message flow.

twilio_shared.label: Ferocity-managed texting
twilio_shared.summary: Managed texting remains unavailable while the provider account and required compliance approvals are unresolved.
twilio_shared.fallback: Use customer-owned Twilio, native SMS handoff, email, or copy-message flow.

voice_ai.label: Voice AI
voice_ai.summary: Retell outbound calling has been certified; inbound routing, owner briefings, and every alternate engine require separate certification.
voice_ai.fallback: Create a human-call task or use the customer's connected phone provider.

stripe.label: Ferocity subscriptions
stripe.summary: Ferocity subscription checkout and billing are live.

stripe_connect.label: Customer invoice payments
stripe_connect.summary: Online invoice payment works after the customer completes Stripe Connect onboarding.
stripe_connect.fallback: Record an offline payment or send payment instructions.

premium_video_rendering.label: AI video generation
premium_video_rendering.summary: Veo generation is live behind budget and authority controls.
premium_video_rendering.fallback: Create a production brief for external rendering.

public_web_chat.label: Website chat
public_web_chat.summary: The native public chat path exists; installation and production-site certification must be completed per website.
public_web_chat.fallback: Use a hosted lead form or contact link.

google_calendar.label: Google Calendar
google_calendar.summary: OAuth and calendar operations are available after a customer connects and authorizes an account.
google_calendar.fallback: Use Ferocity scheduling and iCalendar export.

microsoft_calendar.label: Microsoft Outlook Calendar
microsoft_calendar.summary: OAuth and calendar operations are available after a customer connects and authorizes an account.
microsoft_calendar.fallback: Use Ferocity scheduling and iCalendar export.

google_business_profile.label: Google Business Profile
google_business_profile.summary: Connection and read foundations exist; publishing, reply, and review actions are not all certified live.
google_business_profile.fallback: Prepare drafts and deep-link the user to Google Business Profile.

search_console.label: Google Search Console
search_console.summary: Tenant OAuth, property selection, and read-only 28-day reporting sync are implemented; production connection certification remains per account.
search_console.fallback: Use a website audit and manually supplied search data.

analytics.label: Google Analytics
analytics.summary: Tenant OAuth, GA4 property selection, and read-only 28-day reporting sync are implemented; production connection certification remains per account.
analytics.fallback: Use Ferocity-native attribution and manually imported reports.

google_ads.label: Google Ads
google_ads.summary: Account setup foundations exist; normalized live campaign execution is not certified.
google_ads.fallback: Prepare an approved campaign package for launch in Google Ads.

facebook.label: Meta and Facebook
facebook.summary: Planning and connection surfaces exist, but normalized live publishing and ad execution are not certified.
facebook.fallback: Prepare posts and campaign packages for manual publishing.

tiktok.label: TikTok
tiktok.summary: Login Kit account access is distinct from the Marketing API; live ad execution remains approval-dependent.
tiktok.fallback: Prepare campaign assets and instructions for TikTok Ads Manager.

reddit.label: Reddit Ads
reddit.summary: Funding and setup do not constitute a certified campaign execution adapter.
reddit.fallback: Prepare a campaign package for Reddit Ads Manager.

microsoft_ads.label: Microsoft Advertising
microsoft_ads.summary: Funding and setup do not constitute a certified campaign execution adapter.
microsoft_ads.fallback: Prepare a campaign package for Microsoft Advertising.

jobber.label: Jobber
jobber.summary: OAuth and read-only synchronization have been certified; write-back remains off until separately certified.
jobber.fallback: Use Ferocity independently or import/export records.

highlevel.label: HighLevel
highlevel.summary: A customer-owned location token can write concise Ferocity call notes to mapped contacts; broader coexistence uses the signed bridge.
highlevel.fallback: Use Ferocity independently or configure the signed service-platform bridge.

housecall_pro.label: Housecall Pro
housecall_pro.summary: The signed coexistence bridge is available; native multi-customer write access remains partner-gated.
housecall_pro.fallback: Use Ferocity independently or send the concise call event through approved middleware.

hubspot.label: HubSpot
hubspot.summary: A customer-owned private-app or OAuth token can create native HubSpot call engagements on mapped contacts.
hubspot.fallback: Use Ferocity independently or configure the signed service-platform bridge.

servicetitan.label: ServiceTitan
servicetitan.summary: The signed coexistence bridge is available; a native enterprise adapter requires approved customer and provider access.
servicetitan.fallback: Use Ferocity independently or send approved events through the signed bridge.

quickbooks.label: QuickBooks
quickbooks.summary: Portable accounting and tax exports work; live QuickBooks synchronization is not enabled.
quickbooks.fallback: Export the accounting package for QuickBooks or an accountant.

marketplacepro.label: MarketplacePro
marketplacepro.summary: Signed MarketplacePro events and owner-event handling are live.
marketplacepro.fallback: Reconcile events from the audit log.

supabase_auth.label: Authentication and workspace data
supabase_auth.summary: Authentication and tenant data foundations are live.

webhook_framework.label: Signed webhooks
webhook_framework.summary: The signed webhook framework is live for implemented event contracts.
webhook_framework.fallback: Queue and replay events from the audit log.

calendar_provider.label: Portable calendar
calendar_provider.summary: Ferocity scheduling and iCalendar export work without a third-party calendar account.

external_publishing.label: Website and content publishing
external_publishing.summary: Hosted pages and exportable publishing packages work; arbitrary CMS editing requires a supported connection mode.
external_publishing.fallback: Publish a Ferocity-hosted page or export the content package.
